pairing: Same speaker reads the same numbered text; inside/outside recorded separately, confirmed by user; frequency-domain comparison is primary
raw_normalization: signed PCM32 / 2**31; PCM24 is left-aligned, no additional gain normalization
gt_processing: FFmpeg AAC decode; stereo arithmetic-mean mono; anti-alias resample to 16000 Hz

spectra.method: Hann-window modified periodograms, mean across frames (Welch)
spectra.louder60: top 60% of frames by 100-7000 Hz energy; not a speech VAD
spectra.quiet10: bottom 10% of non-negligible frames; noise proxy only, not a noise measurement
spectra.short_tail: a final remainder shorter than one 512-sample hop is outside the complete-frame PSD; waveform/level checks use every sample

comparison: 10log10[(raw band energy / raw 500-2000 energy)/(GT band energy / GT 500-2000 energy)]
aggregation: per-recording spectral shapes; across-recording median and 25th-75th percentile, equal file weight; no hypothesis testing
alignment: diagnostic only; native rate offset search, >=80% of shorter recording overlap; best stretch search 0.8..1.2 at step 0.005; never applied to spectral estimates
preview: no processed audio exported; candidate evaluated only offline for pole stability and headroom
